dev.description: Run the Deno server and the Vite dev server together

test.description: Run the server's tests and the web app's together

replay.description: Rebuild a test Session from a replay file through the running app (server/replay/)

shot.description: Screenshot the running app in a headless browser, with optional steps (web/scripts/shot.ts)

compile.description: Build the app as one executable, dist/local-roleplay-studio (docs/research/installing.md)
compile.command: cd web && deno task build && deno task build:export && cd ../server && deno compile --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env --allow-sys=hostname,networkInterfaces --include ../web/dist --include ../web/dist-export --include ../python --include ../example-scenarios --include prompts --include images/comfyui/workflows --include voice/comfyui/workflows --include video/comfyui/workflows --include music/comfyui/workflows --exclude-unused-npm --node-modules-dir=none -o ../dist/local-roleplay-studio main.ts

check.description: Lint everything (deno lint), then type-check the server and the web app
check.command: deno lint && cd server && deno check . && cd ../web && deno task typecheck
